capabilities: open help sites for installed plugins and themes in a sidebar view
load remote help pages through an embedded web browser
disambiguation: Not general Obsidian help; it only shows help sites for the plugins and themes installed in the vault.
extras: README warns the plugin connects to the internet solely to load help sites and requires a live internet connection to function.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to read documentation for the plugins and themes you have installed without leaving the app.
summary: Sidebar view that shows the help sites of installed plugins and themes through an embedded web browser.
